note: v57.07 — 거시 rebuilt as two native boards: 거시 경제 (official releases with reference month, release date, next release, source) and 금리 · 환율 (Treasury curve, real yield/breakeven/HY, dollar/won/yen/10Y on the close basis); fixed-threshold storyline, pills, scores and their legacy writers retired (P1425).

p.title: 거시 hub rebuilt as two evidence boards; fixed-threshold verdicts and dead legacy writers retired
p.symptom: Owner review of the 거시 screens: the macro page led with a storyline built on fixed thresholds (10Y >= 4.4% or 2Y >= 4.1% = '금리 부담', SPY +/-0.6% = market tone, a summary that always began 'FOMC 이후 금리 경계'), a regime pill, a hand-written 2020-2026 cycle timeline, an economic thermometer, a scenario tree with fixed probabilities and a collapsed block of blocked widgets; rates and FX appeared twice (macro 6-column row and the FX/bond page). The FX/bond page judged DXY >= 107 or 10Y >= 5% as '높은 수준', counted bull/bear inputs across four axes into a verdict, coloured the 2Y by fixed bands, and its USD/JPY chart read a history field ('jpy') that does not exist. The legacy carry panel still computed the arbitrary-point 58/100 score with US 10Y minus the Bank of Korea rate that P1419 had removed only on the native side. Monthly releases showed no reference month or release date.
p.root_cause: The 거시 routes kept the comp-era layout over legacy writers; each surface added its own thresholds, and the published official macro block (dates, deltas, freshness, sources) never reached a native renderer — only flattened DATA_SNAPSHOT values did.
p.fix: New src/domain/macro/indicators.js (policy, inflation, labor, consumption/housing groups; reference month; release date derived from the official schedule as the first scheduled date after the reference month, BEA releasedAt for PCE; next release; source; the published 2% PCE target as the only comparison) and src/domain/macro/rates-fx.js (official Treasury cut, 2s10s and 5s30s from one cut, inversion stated as fact with the NY Fed reading as a labelled hypothesis, FRED real yield/breakeven/HY with 1-week change, DXY/USDKRW/USDJPY/10Y on the completed-close basis with 1-day and 20-session change and six-month charts, the yen 20-day rule shared with 시장 상태). src/ui/components/macro-board.js renders both; market.js delegates to it. aio-data.js exposes the published macro block on the line that already mirrors its evidence. index.html: macro keeps the transmission lens, WTI/Gold and the KR section; fxbond keeps only live cells for the other currencies; 1,047 lines removed. Legacy deleted: generateMacroStoryline, renderEconCalendar, renderYieldCurve, computeEconomicTemperature, updateMacroRegimePill, updateWtiBrentSpread, _aioSyncMacroLiveSpxMini, updateFxBondPage, loadFxBondTrendCharts, updateCrossAssetMatrix, _aioRenderCarryUnwindRisk, _renderFredCharts, the macro scenario renderer and the macro lazy chart initialiser. Hub tabs read 거시 경제 / 금리 · 환율. The route-registry generator now applies the documented fullNativeOwner policy (zero contested ids and legacy evidence).
p.violated_rule: Owner decisions 2026-10-01/02: remove sourceless widgets and ungrounded grades; one close basis; observation separate from interpretation.
p.prevention: ci-architecture-contract-check P1425 (board hosts and markers present, retired nodes and legacy writers absent); ci-architecture-browser-check P1425 (four groups, CPI card with month/release/source, PCE target gap, five official yields, both spreads, curve fact, three level cards, four close-basis cards, no retired nodes); ci-runtime-contract-check (LC-46/LC-49/EF-01/EF-08/R344 rewritten to the new owners); ci-data-pipeline-contract-check P1419 now reads the rates domain; headless T228/T239/T456/T836/T874/T1206 updated.
p.verification: Local browser at 1440px: 거시 경제 shows 12 indicator cards with correct months and releases (CPI 8월분 9/11, PCE 8월분 9/30, jobs 9월분 10/2); 금리 · 환율 shows the 10/2 official curve 4.83-5.63%, 2s10s +0.45%p, 5s30s +0.57%p, real 2.88%, breakeven 2.36%, HY 324bp, and DXY/원/엔/10Y charts. No runtime exceptions; network errors only from the offline local proxy.
